name: Haruhigaoka Ryou
source:
Ryou is one of the athletic stars of the school, and he is popular among the other students because of this. He's known to sneak away from the dormitory, and apparently had a relationship with a junior student in the past where photographs were taken and sold for profit. He is a rather cunning individual.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/crain/crain.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
